facts.fact: The Seychelles e-Service Gateway offers an online TIN registration form for companies, covering presumptive tax, VAT, employer, business tax and excise registration.
The online company TIN registration form requires the contact person's 11-digit National Identity Number as a mandatory field and shows 'NIN not valid' when it fails validation.
